title: 第10章 “狗带”砸脸
slug: 次元论坛全本免费-次元论坛最新章节列表
content_zh:
钟离家的一处演武场上，不断响起着不和谐的声音！
“你鬼叫什么？我还收着三分力呢！”钟离秋不满的看着抱头鼠窜的关立远。
“请务必只用三分力……”关立远一脸真诚的说道。
“疼疼疼！松口、松口……你怎么能咬人呢？就算要任性，也好歹想起来一下，你是家族大小姐的人设啊！”关立远甩着被咬的胳膊说道。
嗯，上次在“开灵仪式”上，钟离秋的确不止是在吓唬他！
按照魏樱樱的说法，能够被秋小姐咬，也是一种“荣幸”，因为秋小姐到目前为止，据魏樱樱所知，只咬过四个人……一个是她爷爷、一个是她老爹、一个是魏樱樱，还有一个就是关立远。
当然，魏樱樱已经用自己的“姐姐之威严”，成功震慑过钟离秋，加上钟离秋年纪大了之后也不再和她父亲这样撒娇，而她爷爷更是已经去了边境八城……
也就是说现在关立远是唯一能“享受”到这种待遇的人！
“嘁，不是你说三分力的吗？这次真的只有三分……顺便一说，往常我咬人只用一分力！”钟离秋昂首挺胸的说道。
看着胳膊上的几个牙印窟窿，关立远欲哭无泪……
要知道在觉醒为“职业者”后，不仅是多了几个技能，关立远的体质也大幅提高了啊！
就像是田贡好那四个打手大汉，现在关立远不用技能，一挑四也没有问题……
奈何钟离秋成为“圣虎斗士”之后，“咬合力”似乎也再次有所提升，要是之前她用这么大力气，估计关立远这条胳膊已经不能要了。
“为什么‘咬合力’都加强这么多了，其他方面也会加强那么多啊！老天真是不公平……”关立远郁闷的抱怨着。
“你在说什么？先休息一下，十五分钟之后，我们再来练过！”钟离秋说道。
“……”关立远根本没有拒绝的机会。
没错，为了尽快磨练没有任何基础的关立远，魏樱樱和钟离秋想出了实战的方式！
三天过去了，关立远感觉自己突破了一个又一个的极限……他之前从没发现自己这么抗揍！
每次感觉都已经要不行了，不过咬咬牙居然能再挨几拳……
好吧，这极限突破的似乎有些怂。

但是没办法！关立远在三天前，还只是零基础的普通人，即便有自动化程度很高的技能，也完全无法和从小就开始准备成为职业者的钟离秋相比啊！
虽然是双职业，但是关立远的“异界召唤师”职业，根源符文技能是“异界召唤”，用意识与异界的某种存在缔结契约，并且召唤其投影辅助战斗。
三个分支出来的入门技能分别是“潜力开发”、“能力增幅”还有“心灵沟通”，技能名字都很直白，第一系技能就是“异界召唤师”被视为“坑爹”的原罪，第二系技能相当于是给召唤物加BUFF，第三系技能则是与异世界生物沟通用的……
“异界召唤”时关立远不会真的穿越到其他位面，只是意识会随机进入到一个异位面而已，就好像在广撒网的发送、检测电波一样，所以能不能和强大生物缔结契约，就全靠沟通能力了。
因为“异界召唤”仅仅是召唤投影，无论或死或伤，都不会真的伤害到异界生物，因此只要沟通能力够强的话，缔结契约倒是比其他种类的“召唤师”简单……
毕竟和其他种类的“召唤师”缔结契约，就相当于是卖命给他了，而和“异界召唤师”缔结契约，则是多了一个公款旅游的机会！
由关立远消耗精神力，来召唤其投影过来，打输了也不会有什么惩罚，加上除了可以来“异世界”看看，还有聊胜于无的“潜力开发”作为奖励，缔结契约不像其他召唤师那么困难……
然而“简单”只是相对而言，至少现在关立远还没有成功与任何异界生物缔结契约，也不知道是不是钟离家信号不好，所以这一职业暂时用不上。
而另一职业“骨元素使”，根源技能是“骨元素掌控”，类似于被动技能，令职业者能够操纵“骨元素”的根本。
三个衍生的入门技能，除了关立远对打手大汉使用过的“骨刺”之外，还有“骨盾”、“骨索”……
前者是形成一个心口大小，可以在靠近身体周围悬浮的骨元素半实体盾牌，没有“骨刺”的贯穿力，不过却很结实，具有一定的防御能力，至于后者则是可以形成“绊马索”之类的骨质品，胜在能量波动隐蔽。

content_en:
Discordant sounds kept ringing out from a martial arts arena at Zhongli's house!
"What the hell are you calling me? I'm still holding back my third power!" Zhong Liqiu looked dissatisfied at Guan Liyuan, who was running away with his head in his arms.
"Please be sure to only use three points of force..." Guan Liyuan said sincerely.
"It hurts, it hurts! Let go, let go... How can you bite someone? Even if you have to be willful, you should remember that you are the eldest lady of the family!" Guan Liyuan said, shaking the bitten arm.
Well, at the "spiritual opening ceremony" last time, Zhong Liqiu was indeed more than just scaring him!
According to Wei Yingying, it was an "honor" to be bitten by Miss Qiu, because so far, as far as Wei Yingying knew, Miss Qiu had only bitten four people... one was her grandfather, one was her father, one was Wei Yingying, and the other was Guan Liyuan.
Of course, Wei Yingying has successfully intimidated Zhong Liqiu with her "sister's majesty". In addition, Zhong Liqiu no longer acts like a spoiled child with her father when she gets older, and her grandfather has already gone to the eight cities on the border...
In other words, Guan Liyuan is the only person who can "enjoy" this kind of treatment now!
"Hey, didn't you say three points of force? This time it was really only three points... By the way, I usually bite people with only one point of force!" Zhong Liqiu said with his head held high.
Looking at the several teeth marks and holes on his arm, Guan Liyuan felt like crying...
You must know that after awakening as a "professional", not only did Guan Liyuan gain a few more skills, but Guan Liyuan's physical fitness also improved significantly!
Just like Tian Gonghao's four thugs, Guan Li doesn't need any skills now, so he has no problem fighting against four...
However, after Zhong Liqiu became the "Holy Tiger Fighter", her "biting force" seemed to have improved again. If she had used such force before, Guan Liyuan would probably no longer be able to keep this arm.
"Why is it that even if the 'biting force' has been strengthened so much, other aspects will also be strengthened so much! It's really unfair..." Guan Liyuan complained depressedly.
"What are you talking about? Take a rest first, and we will practice again in fifteen minutes!" Zhong Liqiu said.
"..." Guan Liyuan had no chance to refuse.
That's right, in order to hone Guan Liyuan without any foundation as soon as possible, Wei Yingying and Zhong Liqiu came up with a practical method!
Three days have passed, and Guan Liyuan feels like he has broken through one limit after another... He has never found himself so resistant to beatings before!
Every time I feel like I'm on the verge of death, but I grit my teeth and survive a few more punches...
Okay, this limit breakthrough seems a bit timid.
But there is no way! Three days ago, Guan Liyuan was just an ordinary person with zero basic skills. Even if he had highly automated skills, he was completely unable to compare with Zhong Liqiu, who had been preparing to become a professional since he was a child!
Although he has dual professions, Guan Liyuan's "Alien Summoner" profession has the root rune skill of "Alien Summoning". He uses his consciousness to form a contract with some kind of existence in the other world and summons its projection to assist in combat.
The three branches of entry-level skills are "potential development", "ability increase" and "spiritual communication". The names of the skills are very straightforward. The first series of skills is the original sin of "alien summoner" being regarded as a "cheating". The second series of skills is equivalent to adding BUFF to the summoned objects, and the third series of skills is used to communicate with creatures from other worlds...
When "Summoning from Another World", Guan Liyuan will not really travel to other planes, but his consciousness will randomly enter an alien plane, just like sending and detecting radio waves in a wide net, so whether he can form a contract with powerful creatures depends entirely on his communication ability.
Because "Alien Summoning" is just a summoning projection, no matter whether it is dead or injured, it will not really harm the alien creatures. Therefore, as long as the communication ability is strong enough, it is easier to conclude a contract than other types of "Summoners"...
After all, it is relatively easy to make a contract with other types of "summoners"It means that you have given your life to him, and by signing a contract with the "Summoner from Another World", you have an additional opportunity to travel with public funds!
Guan Liyuan consumes his mental power to summon his projection, and there will be no penalty if he loses. In addition, in addition to being able to visit the "different world", there is also a better-than-nothing "potential development" as a reward. Concluding a contract is not as difficult as other summoners...
However, "simple" is only a relative term. At least for now, Guan Liyuan has not successfully concluded a contract with any otherworldly creature. He doesn't know if the Zhongli family's signal is not good, so this profession is temporarily unavailable.
As for another profession, "Bone Elementalist", the root skill is "Bone Element Control", which is similar to a passive skill and allows the profession to control the root of "Bone Element".
The three derived entry-level skills, in addition to the "Bone Spur" that Guan Liyuan used against the big man, are also the "Bone Shield" and "Bone Rope"...
The former forms a heart-sized semi-solid shield of bone elements that can be suspended close to the body. It does not have the penetrating power of "bone spurs", but is very strong and has certain defensive capabilities. As for the latter, it can form bone products such as "trip ropes", which are better than concealing energy fluctuations.
